highlights.title: Your race goal shows the next step
highlights.description: Open a race goal in Settings to see one next step, such as adding a finish time or updating phases.

highlights.title: One clear read on your week's effort
highlights.description: Goal readiness now sums up how hard your whole week was against the plan, in a redesigned view.

highlights.title: Race phases with example workouts
highlights.description: See every phase, its weekly hours and example workouts on one screen, opened from Plan.

highlights.title: The coach accepts a plain yes
highlights.description: In coach chat, your own words now clear a healed illness or injury and confirm deleting a plan.

highlights.title: A tab bar that makes room
highlights.description: The tab bar shrinks while you scroll and stays compact on Plan, giving your week more room.

highlights.title: Clearer workouts in your plan
highlights.description: Open any workout to see readable targets, coaching instructions and completed activity insights.

highlights.title: Easy rides get a watt target
highlights.description: If you train on power, easy rides in your plan show their power zone in watts and are scored on it.

highlights.title: Today keeps your day after a workout
highlights.description: The day card marks your session done with its score and shows week changes and tomorrow on Today.

highlights.title: Let your club coach run a session
highlights.description: Mark a recurring session as coach-led in Settings and your plan keeps that slot free.

highlights.title: Keep e-bike rides out of training
highlights.description: One switch in Activity handling makes every Strava e-bike ride count as everyday.

highlights.title: Ask your coach more
highlights.description: Your coach is more reliable and can do more, so ask about your training or have it adapt your plan.

highlights.title: Strength no longer cuts your runs
highlights.description: Your week plans the full endurance dose, with strength and mobility on top within your time.

highlights.title: Your week in review comes to you
highlights.description: Shortly after your week's last session, the review is written, pushed and leads on Today.

highlights.title: Four weeks at a glance
highlights.description: Pull down the Plan calendar to see four weeks, then hold a session and drop it on another day.

highlights.title: Exact power targets on your watch
highlights.description: Your watch now uses the watt range written in your workout.

highlights.title: Your coach's verdict comes first
highlights.description: Open an activity to see its score, your coach's summary and what to do next time.

highlights.title: Activities grouped by week
highlights.description: See each week's sessions and hours against your plan, with every score in its colour.

highlights.title: All your updates in one place
highlights.description: Tap the bell on Today to see coaching updates, even with push turned off.

highlights.title: A calmer Plan header
highlights.description: See your phase and this week's hours at a glance, and tap the i for your coach's plan and reasons.

highlights.title: Add your name and photo
highlights.description: Change your name and add a profile photo in Settings under Profile & Account.

highlights.title: Simpler settings and training days
highlights.description: Settings is shorter, and preferred training days are now optional and explained.

highlights.title: Edits and saves work more reliably
highlights.description: You can now remove an old goal target or camp note, and a failed save shows an error.

highlights.title: Plan next week in three steps
highlights.description: The week planner now asks three short questions, one screen each.

highlights.title: Race phases, step by step
highlights.description: Race goal setup now checks your goal, then builds your training phases, one step at a time.

highlights.title: Your weekly target stays as planned
highlights.description: Cut a session and Today asks once whether to make up the minutes or lower the target.

highlights.title: Intensity now judged per session
highlights.description: Each session's intensity is now compared with what it asked for, warm-up and cool-down included.

highlights.title: Plan next week in a few questions
highlights.description: When your week ends, a short flow asks about next week and builds the plan from your answers.

highlights.title: Your coach can start week planning
highlights.description: Ask your coach to plan next week and a button under the reply opens the planner.

highlights.title: Pause, resume or delete commitments
highlights.description: Your fixed weekly sessions can now be paused, resumed or deleted on the Commitments screen.

highlights.title: Your own heart-rate zones stay yours
highlights.description: Zones you set yourself now switch that sport to Manual and are no longer deleted.

highlights.title: Your plan grows at a pace you choose
highlights.description: Choose how fast your weekly volume may grow in your training profile.

highlights.title: Race goal check keeps running
highlights.description: Leave your race goal review and follow its progress on Today until it needs you.

highlights.title: Check your goal before planning
highlights.description: Setting up a race goal now checks whether your target fits your training time.

highlights.title: Your day card follows plan changes
highlights.description: Change today's session and your coach rewrites its note on Today to match.

highlights.title: Set your own heart-rate zones
highlights.description: Enter your own zone limits from a lab test or watch under HR zones in Settings.

highlights.title: Today starts with your day
highlights.description: Today now opens with one card: your session, why your coach chose it and what changed.

highlights.title: Coach asks before reopening a day
highlights.description: Ask for a session on a blocked day and the coach asks whether to reopen it or keep it free.

highlights.title: Update notes you can read in full
highlights.description: What's New now shows every change in full and lists all updates since you last looked.

highlights.title: Choose your app icon
highlights.description: Pick the classic or a new glossy icon under Profile, App Icon.

highlights.title: Tell the app which session you did
highlights.description: Open an activity and pick the planned session it belongs to from its menu.

highlights.title: A clearer start to your training
highlights.description: Setup now keeps your preview and progress if something goes wrong or you restart the app.

highlights.title: A calmer coach chat
highlights.description: Approve your coach's plan changes one by one right in the chat, without a separate screen.

highlights.title: Intervals read against your plan
highlights.description: Planned interval runs now come back as the reps you were given, each with its own pace.

highlights.title: Your first plan starts from history
highlights.description: Connect Strava and your first plan starts from your last 8 weeks of real training.

highlights.title: Compare a session with its plan
highlights.description: An activity's insights now show the planned session next to what you actually did.

highlights.title: Camps now include hiking
highlights.description: Add hiking to a camp and mountain days are planned as real hikes of two to five hours.

highlights.title: Multi-day race times now correct
highlights.description: Race finish times now count every stop, and finishes over 24 hours can be entered.

highlights.title: Camp days are no longer overfilled
highlights.description: A camp's daily hours are now the most one day can hold, not a quota for every day.

highlights.title: Fast reps no longer get a fake pace
highlights.description: Your Z5 pace now comes only from your real short reps, not from heart-rate guesses.

highlights.title: A briefing that knows how you slept
highlights.description: Your morning briefing now arrives at 7 and updates once with your overnight recovery.

highlights.title: A guided restart after a break
highlights.description: After a training gap, Generate checks whether your phases still fit before planning the week.

highlights.title: Reopen a day you blocked out
highlights.description: Blocked days now show in your Plan, and one tap on 'I'm available after all' reopens them.

highlights.title: Deep-dive any workout from chat
highlights.description: Ask the coach to analyze any recent workout right in the chat, without opening it first.

highlights.title: Volume questions get their own card
highlights.description: Suggestions to raise or lower your weekly target now get their own card on Today.

highlights.title: Coach sees your heart-rate zones
highlights.description: Ask your coach about a session and it answers with your time in each heart-rate zone.

highlights.title: Time in each zone is now correct
highlights.description: Time-in-zone figures now count real seconds instead of being about four times too short.

highlights.title: Ultra and trail races as goal types
highlights.description: Pick Ultra Marathon or Other Running Race when you create a race goal.

highlights.title: Your weekly target recovers with you
highlights.description: Clear an injury or illness and your coach offers to restore your earlier weekly target.

highlights.title: One weekly target you control
highlights.description: Your week has one target at the top of your Plan that changes only when you change it.

highlights.title: Report a problem through your coach
highlights.description: When something breaks, your coach can forward a report to the developer with your permission.

highlights.title: Plan changes say what didn't apply
highlights.description: Confirmed plan changes now name anything that could not be applied, with the reason.

highlights.title: Goal readiness in one place
highlights.description: Your goal readiness now sits in one card at the top of Today, with the reasons behind it.

highlights.title: Record a race that went wrong
highlights.description: After race day, tell us if you finished, did not finish or did not start, and your training adapts.

highlights.title: Mid-week plans keep your training
highlights.description: A plan created mid-week now shows the workouts you already did instead of blank rest days.

highlights.title: Long races sync completely
highlights.description: Ultra activities with more than 10,000 m of climbing now import instead of disappearing.

highlights.title: See what is behind your readiness
highlights.description: Tap the readiness banner on Today for a breakdown, and your race forecast now updates mid-week.

highlights.title: Upload your race course as GPX
highlights.description: Attach a GPX file to your race goal to see its elevation profile and get terrain-based race tactics.

highlights.title: Weekly hours that fit your training
highlights.description: If you train well above or below your weekly hours for weeks, your coach suggests a new baseline.

highlights.title: See where your race time is heading
highlights.description: Your race goal now shows a weekly finish-time forecast, charted against your target time.

highlights.title: Plans built for trail running
highlights.description: Trail and mountain runners now get climbing targets, hill intervals and downhill work in their plan.

highlights.title: Your fixed sessions stay in the plan
highlights.description: Tell your coach about regular sessions like a Tuesday club run and every weekly plan includes them.

highlights.title: Add a second workout to a day
highlights.description: Ask your coach for an extra session and it is added next to the day's existing workout.

highlights.title: Race Debrief now on Android
highlights.description: After a race, the Race Debrief now walks you through your training block on Android too.

highlights.title: Morning metrics now in color
highlights.description: Your HRV, resting heart rate and sleep tiles on Today now turn green or red when they shift.

highlights.title: Clearer next step after a race
highlights.description: The card after your race now points to your Race Debrief and goes away once your next goal is set.

highlights.title: Race Debrief helps you tidy up
highlights.description: After your Race Debrief, your coach suggests updates for your goals and memories that you confirm.

highlights.title: Readiness carries across weeks
highlights.description: Your goal readiness no longer resets every Monday and counts your goal sports most.

highlights.title: See your triathlon as one race
highlights.description: A new whole-race view shows swim, bike, run and transitions of your triathlon together.

highlights.title: Better matching on two-workout days
highlights.description: On days with several activities, each one is now matched to the right planned workout.

highlights.title: Always know where you stand
highlights.description: A card on Today now shows whether you are on track for your goal this week.

highlights.title: Readiness and check-in on one card
highlights.description: Your goal readiness and morning check-in now share one card at the top of Today.

highlights.title: Race Debrief for your training block
highlights.description: After a big race, open the Race Debrief on your goal to see what your training block taught you.

highlights.title: Overnight recovery from Apple Health
highlights.description: Your HRV, resting heart rate and sleep from Apple Health now show on Today each morning.

highlights.title: Change settings by chatting
highlights.description: Tell your coach your new weekly hours, zones or race date and it makes the change in the chat.

highlights.title: See the impact before a plan change
highlights.description: When your coach suggests a plan change, the card shows how it moves your goal readiness.

highlights.title: Give your coach a name
highlights.description: Name your coach in Settings and it shows up in the chat header.

highlights.title: Set a goal at any race distance
highlights.description: Pick Custom when adding a race goal to enter any distance, such as an ultra.

highlights.title: Push notifications on Android
highlights.description: Android now gets push notifications for your plan, briefings and coach, set up in Settings.

highlights.title: Weather on your plan
highlights.description: Your plan cards now show the day's forecast and high and low temperature.

highlights.title: Choose miles or kilometres
highlights.description: Switch the app to imperial units like miles and Fahrenheit in Settings.

highlights.title: Pick up where you left off
highlights.description: After a break, Today offers a quick way to bring your plan back up to date.

highlights.title: Race weather at the venue
highlights.description: Add your race's start location and time to get race-day weather for the venue.

highlights.title: Race feedback can be edited
highlights.description: You can now reopen and change your race notes, rating and official time after saving.

highlights.title: A redesigned workout screen
highlights.description: Tap a workout in your Plan to open a full-screen view with one clear next action.

highlights.title: No duplicate Apple Health workouts
highlights.description: A workout recorded by two apps in Apple Health now shows up only once.

highlights.title: Full insights for Apple Watch
highlights.description: Apple Watch athletes now get the same analysis as Strava users, with your history imported.

highlights.title: Easier workout feedback
highlights.description: Your workout feedback now opens above the keyboard and stays visible on the activity.

highlights.title: Review coach plan changes clearly
highlights.description: When the coach proposes changes, a review screen lets you compare and pick the ones you want.

highlights.title: Your coach keeps its notes current
highlights.description: Each week your coach tidies outdated notes about you and asks on Today when unsure.

highlights.title: A weekly review that connects
highlights.description: Your Week in Review now highlights your wins and remembers last week's focus.

highlights.title: Faster long coach chats
highlights.description: Long conversations in the coach chat stay quick, and unconfirmed plan proposals expire after a day.

highlights.title: Watch intervals keep their durations
highlights.description: Interval workouts sent to Apple Watch now keep their minute durations instead of seconds.

highlights.title: Drag-and-drop rescheduling works
highlights.description: Dragging a workout onto a busy day in your Plan now adds it as a second session.

highlights.title: See when next week is being planned
highlights.description: Your Plan now shows a loading state while next week is built, then the new week appears.

highlights.title: Your coach remembers your chats
highlights.description: What you tell the coach now carries into your next workout analysis and plan changes.

highlights.title: Coach edits keep your other sessions
highlights.description: Changing one of two sessions on a day no longer deletes the other one.

highlights.title: Coach moves the same workout

highlights.title: Re-plan a week in a training camp

highlights.title: Rearrange first, review later

highlights.title: Strava deletions and re-syncs work

highlights.title: See what a plan change changes
highlights.description: Plan adjustments now show a before and after for each workout, like 70 min to 40 min.

highlights.title: Race briefing at 6 PM the day before
highlights.description: Your race briefing now arrives at 6 PM the day before, and Today celebrates your finish.

highlights.title: Race briefing the night before
highlights.description: The evening before a race, your coach sends a briefing with pacing, tactics and fueling.

highlights.title: Mark the days you can't train
highlights.description: When you generate a plan, tap the days you're out and the coach plans rest there.

highlights.title: Plans are built in the background
highlights.description: Tap Generate and keep using the app, and a push tells you when your week is ready.

highlights.title: Swipe to dismiss is back on Today
highlights.description: Activity insight and weekly progress cards on Today can be swiped away again.

highlights.title: See why today's workout matters
highlights.description: Tap the Why button on Today to see how today's session fits your goal and phase.

highlights.title: See why today's workout fits
highlights.description: Tap the Why button on Today to see how the workout fits your goal and recent sessions.

highlights.title: Today adapts to your day
highlights.description: Today now looks different in the morning, after a workout and on rest days.

highlights.title: Swipe Today cards away
highlights.description: Swipe a card on Today to the left to remove it.

highlights.title: A calmer Plan tab
highlights.description: Your Plan now opens on larger day cards with a calendar you can pull open.

highlights.title: A shorter start
highlights.description: Pick your sport, goal and weekly hours to get your first plan, and fine-tune the rest later.

highlights.title: Enter threshold and max HR together
highlights.description: Manual HR zone setup now takes both values, so your top zone uses your real max HR.

highlights.title: Coach asks before applying changes
highlights.description: The coach now asks before changing your plan and remembers a pending proposal.

highlights.title: Coach insights clear after you reply
highlights.description: A coach insight on Today now leaves once you send the coach a message about it.

highlights.title: Control what your coach keeps
highlights.description: In Settings you can now reset your coach history or delete all saved memories.

highlights.title: Logged workouts show real distance
highlights.description: Completed workouts in your Plan now show the distance you actually covered.

highlights.title: Coach insights open with context
highlights.description: Tap a coach insight on Today and the chat opens with that insight already shown.

highlights.title: What's New fits the screen again
highlights.description: Long What's New highlights now scroll, so the Close button stays visible.

highlights.title: Plan changes come first on Today
highlights.description: A suggested plan change is now the top card on Today, with a count of what changes.

highlights.title: Review plan changes from Today
highlights.description: Tap the Plan Adjustment card on Today to review and approve the changes right there.

highlights.title: Two races in one week plan correctly
highlights.description: With two races in one week, your plan now has a race workout on each race day.

highlights.title: Race goals complete reliably
highlights.description: Submitting your official finish time now marks the race goal as complete right away.

highlights.title: Today briefing on the web
highlights.description: The web dashboard now shows your daily briefing next to your weekly plan.

highlights.title: Simpler morning check-in
highlights.description: Tell the coach on Today whether you feel good, tired or unwell.

highlights.title: Easier workout when you feel off
highlights.description: Report feeling tired or unwell and the coach suggests an easier version of today's workout.

highlights.title: Your daily briefing on Today
highlights.description: Today shows your workout, weather alerts and coach insights each morning.

highlights.title: Morning check-in
highlights.description: Tell your coach each morning how you feel so today's training can adjust.

highlights.title: Coach insights on Today
highlights.description: Pro members get coach insights on Today about patterns in their training.

highlights.title: Settings work offline

highlights.description: Opening Location or What's New without a connection no longer crashes the app.

highlights.description: Offline, save buttons are disabled with a hint instead of failing silently.

highlights.title: Connect Apple Health
highlights.description: Sync workouts, heart rate, power and routes from Apple Health in Settings.

highlights.title: Duplicate workouts are merged
highlights.description: With Strava and Apple Health connected, the same workout is only counted once.

highlights.description: Mark recovery weeks, travel or busy periods as a Slow Down camp to lower your weekly volume.

highlights.title: Delete a camp plan, keep the camp

highlights.title: Pick camp dates on a calendar

highlights.title: Choose your weather location
highlights.description: Search for a city in Settings to set where your weather forecast comes from.

highlights.title: Add a location to your camp
highlights.description: Give a camp a location and its plan uses the weather forecast for that place.

highlights.description: Your weekly plan now takes the weather forecast into account when placing outdoor sessions.

highlights.title: Tell the coach what your camp needs
highlights.description: Add your own instructions when you create or regenerate a training camp plan.

highlights.title: Change your plan from any screen

highlights.title: Clearer sport levels in your profile
highlights.description: Pick your level per sport from 1 to 5 in Settings, each with a short description.

highlights.title: Delete or reanalyze an activity
highlights.description: Use the menu on an activity's insights to delete it or refresh its analysis.

highlights.description: From an activity, ask the coach to refresh its analysis, sync from Strava or delete it.

highlights.title: A shorter, clearer weekly review
highlights.description: Your Week in Review now leads with one coach summary, an outlook and concrete suggestions.

highlights.title: Review your week on the weekend
highlights.description: Start your Week in Review on Saturday or Sunday, even with workouts still planned.

highlights.description: Adapt Phases now shows what will change and why before you accept or reject it.

highlights.description: Your Week in Review now assesses progress and suggests updates to your coach's notes.

highlights.description: Ask for a plan change in chat mode and the coach offers a one-tap switch to Plan mode.
